arguments.summary: Prepared T12, rent roll and lease extractions; computed underwriting, value and loan sizing per lender rules. Maximum loan $6.596MM (DSCR). First-year IO debt service at contract rate 6.75% equals $445k. Net cash to borrower estimated $2.243MM after payoff, origination and fixed costs. Stress case with EGI -5% and +100 bps sizing rate sizes to $5.643MM. Workbook with live formulas and an internal memorandum PDF are attached and cited.
